title: Boiled Lime Cake with Lime Icing
description: Whole limes are boiled skin-on for 10 minutes, then blended into a batter with eggs, sugar, milk, and neutral oil. The result is an intensely limey snack cake finished with a simple powdered-sugar glaze.

steps.title: Boil limes whole
steps.text: Place {i01} in a saucepan, cover with water, and boil whole with the skin on for 10 minutes. Remove and let cool slightly.

steps.title: Blend lime with wet ingredients
steps.text: Transfer the boiled {i01} to a blender or food processor. Add {i02}, {i03}, {i04}, {i05}, {i06}, and {i07}. Blend until smooth.

steps.title: Combine with dry ingredients
steps.text: Add {i08} and {i09} to the blended wet mixture and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour the batter into a greased baking pan and bake at 325°F for 45–55 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Make icing
steps.text: While the cake cools, whisk together {i10}, {i11}, and {i12} until smooth.

steps.title: Ice and serve
steps.text: Drizzle or spread the icing over the cooled cake and serve.

rawText:
CAPTION (as written by the author -- trust these amounts):
When life give you limes 

Here’s the recipe my boi 
* 2 limes
* 3 eggs
* 175g sugar
* 50g whole milk
* 65g neutral oil
* 1 Tbsp vanilla bean paste
* 1/4 tsp salt
* 250g AP flour
* 2 1/2 tsp baking powder

For the icing

* 1 cup powdered sugar
* 1 tsp lime juice
* 2 Tbsp water

325F for 45-55
